topCareers.name: Compensation and Benefits Managers
topCareers.jobDescription: Plan, direct, or coordinate compensation and benefits activities of an organization.

topCareers.name: Training and Development Managers
topCareers.jobDescription: Plan, direct, or coordinate the training and development activities and staff of an organization.

topCareers.name: Chief Sustainability Officers
topCareers.jobDescription: Communicate and coordinate with management, shareholders, customers, and employees to address sustainability issues. Enact or oversee a corporate sustainability strategy.

topCareers.name: Natural Sciences Managers
topCareers.jobDescription: Plan, direct, or coordinate activities in such fields as life sciences, physical sciences, mathematics, statistics, and research and development in these fields.

topCareers.name: Water Resource Specialists
topCareers.jobDescription: Design or implement programs and strategies related to water resource issues such as supply, quality, and regulatory compliance issues.

topCareers.name: Wind Energy Development Managers
topCareers.jobDescription: Lead or manage the development and evaluation of potential wind energy business opportunities, including environmental studies, permitting, and proposals. May also manage construction of projects.

topCareers.name: Brownfield Redevelopment Specialists and Site Managers
topCareers.jobDescription: Plan and direct cleanup and redevelopment of contaminated properties for reuse. Does not include properties sufficiently contaminated to qualify as Superfund sites.

topCareers.name: Software Developers
topCareers.jobDescription: Research, design, and develop computer and network software or specialized utility programs. Analyze user needs and develop software solutions, applying principles and techniques of computer science, engineering, and mathematical analysis. topCareers.name: Computer Network Architects
topCareers.jobDescription: Design and implement computer and information networks, such as local area networks (LAN), wide area networks (WAN), intranets, extranets, and other data communications networks. Perform network modeling, analysis, and planning, including analysis of capacity needs for network infrastructures. May also design network and computer security measures. topCareers.name: Aerospace Engineers
topCareers.jobDescription: Perform engineering duties in designing, constructing, and testing aircraft, missiles, and spacecraft. May conduct basic and applied research to evaluate adaptability of materials and equipment to aircraft design and manufacture. May recommend improvements in testing equipment and techniques.

topCareers.name: Chemical Engineers
topCareers.jobDescription: Design chemical plant equipment and devise processes for manufacturing chemicals and products, such as gasoline, synthetic rubber, plastics, detergents, cement, paper, and pulp, by applying principles and technology of chemistry, physics, and engineering.

topCareers.name: Computer Hardware Engineers
topCareers.jobDescription: Research, design, develop, or test computer or computer-related equipment for commercial, industrial, military, or scientific use. May supervise the manufacturing and installation of computer or computer-related equipment and components.

topCareers.name: Electronics Engineers, Except Computer
topCareers.jobDescription: Research, design, develop, or test electronic components and systems for commercial, industrial, military, or scientific use employing knowledge of electronic theory and materials properties. Design electronic circuits and components for use in fields such as telecommunications, aerospace guidance and propulsion control, acoustics, or instruments and controls.

topCareers.name: Radio Frequency Identification Device Specialists
topCareers.jobDescription: Design and implement radio frequency identification device (RFID) systems used to track shipments or goods.

topCareers.name: Nuclear Engineers
topCareers.jobDescription: Conduct research on nuclear engineering projects or apply principles and theory of nuclear science to problems concerned with release, control, and use of nuclear energy and nuclear waste disposal.

topCareers.name: Hydroelectric Production Managers
topCareers.jobDescription: Manage operations at hydroelectric power generation facilities. Maintain and monitor hydroelectric plant equipment for efficient and safe plant operations.

topCareers.name: Regulatory Affairs Managers
topCareers.jobDescription: Plan, direct, or coordinate production activities of an organization to ensure compliance with regulations and standard operating procedures.

topCareers.name: Public Relations Managers
topCareers.jobDescription: Plan, direct, or coordinate activities designed to create or maintain a favorable public image or raise issue awareness for their organization or client.

topCareers.name: Fundraising Managers
topCareers.jobDescription: Plan, direct, or coordinate activities to solicit and maintain funds for special projects or nonprofit organizations.

topCareers.name: Human Resources Managers
topCareers.jobDescription: Plan, direct, or coordinate human resources activities and staff of an organization.
